name: heyimjames
description: Five detailed Swift/SwiftUI design-engineering skills by James Frewin — iOS camera & photos, iOS chat & messaging, iOS interaction primitives (widgets, Live Activities, Dynamic Island, haptics, Wallet passes), the final 5% of polish (motion physics, OKLCH+Display P3 color, typography, MeshGradient backgrounds, shareable image generation), and native macOS app design (OpenAI Codex / Linear / Things 3 quality — window architecture, sidebars, menu bar, keyboard shortcuts, Liquid Glass on Tahoe). After install, invoke via heyimjames:camera-and-photos, heyimjames:chat-and-messaging, heyimjames:interaction-primitives, heyimjames:the-final-5-percent, heyimjames:macos-app-design.
